info.title: Fusion HCM (connection probe)
info.description: Deliberately small. This exists to prove the VB server-side proxy reaches the Fusion pod and authenticates — not to be the module's data path. Master data still arrives through integration/bip into the OC_TIME_* cache, which is what OC_TIME_PKG can enforce rules over. Add operations here only for a lookup the cache genuinely cannot answer.

servers.description: Resolved by VB from services/catalog.json. The browser never sees the pod url or any credential.

get.summary: Connection probe. Asks HCM for a single worker and nothing else — the cheapest call that still proves auth, routing and payload shape all work.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Kept at 1. This is a reachability check, not a data pull — integration/bip fetches all 5976 workers, and doing that here would be both slow and pointless.

parameters.name: onlyData
parameters.description: Drops Fusion's HATEOAS links block, which is far larger than the record itself.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: PersonNumber is what OC_TIME_WORKER.EMPLOYEE_ID holds, so seeing one confirms the two systems agree on the key. INT-001 notes the PersonNumber -> PersonId hop.

401.description: The proxy reached Fusion but the credentials were refused

403.description: Authenticated, but the service account lacks the HCM data role

404.description: Wrong resource path or REST version for this pod
